Command `cd /workspace/pandas-dev__pandas; sed -n 556,580p pandas/core/reshape/reshape.py; cd /tmp; PYTHONPATH=/tmp/hyb python - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd
df = pd.DataFrame({"idx": [0, 1, 0, 1], "col": ["a", "a", "b", "b"], "ints": [10, 20, 30, 40], "floats": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4], "strs": ["A", "B", "C", "D"]})
print(df[["ints","floats"]]._values.dtype, df[["ints","strs"]]._values.dtype, df[["ints"]]._values.dtype)
print(df.pivot(index="idx", columns="col", values=["ints","strs"]).dtypes.to_dict())
print(pd.pivot(df, index="idx", columns="col", values=["ints","floats"]).dtypes.to_dict())
for v in ["ints", ["ints"]]:
    print(df.pivot(index="idx", columns="col", values=v).dtypes.tolist())
print(df.pivot(index="idx", columns="col").dtypes.to_dict())
print(df.pivot_table(index="idx", columns="col", values=["ints","floats"], aggfunc="first").dtypes.to_dict())
print(df.set_index(["idx", "col"])[["ints", "floats"]].unstack("col").dtypes.to_dict())
print(df.pivot(index="idx", columns="col", values=("ints")).dtypes.tolist())
EOF` executed with exit code 0.
